title: AEC official tests the device on himself

tellings.quote: one of the guys is like, "I don't believe you, you know, test me." And just and and and did the test on himself and it worked.

plain: In 1962 or 1963, at a New York City company called Intelectron, an official from the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran the country's nuclear work, is said to have doubted a device the company was working on, told them "test me," tried it on himself, and found that it worked. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this on Jesse Michels' show. He sums it up without naming a source, though he points to the writer Annie Jacobsen and to letters from the Atomic Energy Commission. If true, a skeptical government official saw the device work on his own body.
